Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly conflated Warner Bros. Nashville (a label under Warner Music Group) with Warner Bros. Entertainment, leading to the incorrect ownership path toward Warner Bros. Discovery. This misinterpretation of the corporate hierarchy—driven by the “Warner Bros.” naming overlap and lack of authoritative confirmation—could have produced a wrong answer by attributing ownership to Warner Bros. Discovery instead of Warner Music Group.
